<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₈H₈O (neutral mass 120.0575 Da), which is within typical instrument tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C₈H₈O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8O</final_answer>
